description:
The person's claim steps for a company's settlement: whether the code on the notice letter is needed, which benefit fits their answers, what to gather, the deadline, and the official claim form link. The person files and signs on the official site.

Example questions:
- "How do I file a claim for the Columbia University settlement?"
- "I lost my notice letter, can I still claim?"
- "What do I need to claim the DaVita settlement?"

company.description: The company or organization named on the letter or in the news. Nothing else about the person.

got_notice_letter.description: Optional: true if they got a notice letter or email

had_out_of_pocket_losses.description: Optional: true if they paid money or lost time because of the breach

name: how_to_file_breach_claim
title: How do I file a claim for the X data-breach settlement?
